ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution across visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region on the left lobe bisected by dark radial streaks. Right lobe is predominantly low-intensity black with high-frequency white mottling/speckling. Symmetrical dark pigmentation along the entire trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees and shallow relative depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the right lobe trailing edge with deep indentations. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-amplitude, more regular serrated topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature with a steep upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (yellow-white) concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Minor white speckling across the dark pigmentation of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous low-intensity linear rake marks and scratches cutting across the high-intensity white field of the left lobe, radiating from the peduncle toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on the tips; significant jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe suggests mechanical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small reddish-white high-intensity region at the base of the peduncle junction.
